masseng_boundary.used: standalone synthetic demonstration (NOT MASSENG v5 output)
masseng_boundary.note: evaluation designs; MASSENG has no learning/labour modules

label: SIMULATION - known-truth identification demonstrations; no causal claim
plain_result: Each design recovers its target in its own known-truth world and is near zero in the no-effect control; the naive estimators are biased in the stated violation worlds (IV 1.49 vs OLS 1.76 against a true 1.5; TWFE bias -0.50 vs the group-time estimator -0.02). This is a demonstration of the designs, not an estimate of any real programme.

statistical_frame.estimand: each design target (ATT, IV coefficient, RD jump, SC gap)
statistical_frame.identification: design-specific assumptions stated per synthetic world
statistical_frame.pass_fail: PASS if null worlds near zero and design estimators closer than naive
